events.title: 1,000 Wishlists!
events.summary: Three days into Steam Next Fest, Beneath Paris has passed 1,000 wishlists 🎉Thank you to everyone who has played the demo, wishlisted or shared it.This Next Fest is a crowded one, with over 7,000+ games and 1,000+ in the horror category alone, so it’s easy for Beneath Paris to get lost in the crowd. That’s why every play, wishlist and share has meant so much.I also want to thank everyone who has left a review. The demo has 24 so far, every one of them positive, and I’ve read each one - thank you
